artists.name: The Weeknd
artists.bio: Abel Makkonen Tesfaye, known professionally as The Weeknd, is a Canadian singer, songwriter, and record producer. Renowned for his unconventional music production, artistic reinventions, and his signature use of the falsetto register.

artists.name: Taylor Swift
artists.bio: Taylor Alison Swift is an American singer-songwriter. Her multifaceted songwriting, artistic reinventions, and cultural influence have made her a defining figure of contemporary popular culture.

artists.name: Billie Eilish
artists.bio: Billie Eilish Pirate Baird O'Connell is an American singer-songwriter. She first gained public attention in 2015 with her debut single Ocean Eyes and has won numerous Grammy Awards and Academy Awards.

artists.name: Kendrick Lamar
artists.bio: Kendrick Lamar Duckworth is an American rapper and songwriter. Widely regarded as one of the most influential hip-hop artists of his generation and one of the greatest rappers of all time.

artists.name: Dua Lipa
artists.bio: Dua Lipa is an English and Albanian singer and songwriter. Her mezzo-soprano vocal range and disco-pop production have earned her critical acclaim and global commercial success.

artists.name: Drake
artists.bio: Aubrey Drake Graham is a Canadian rapper, singer, and songwriter. An influential figure in contemporary popular music, he is credited with popularizing singing and R&B sensibilities in hip hop.

artists.name: Queen
artists.bio: Queen are a British rock band formed in London in 1970 by Freddie Mercury, Brian May, Roger Taylor, and later joined by John Deacon. Their classic hits remain timeless anthems.

artists.name: Arctic Monkeys
artists.bio: Arctic Monkeys are an English rock band formed in Sheffield in 2002. The group consists of Alex Turner, Jamie Cook, Nick O'Malley, and Matt Helders.
